title: Normalized kernel, derivation and torsor data for scheme lifts
statement: For a marked flat lift $Y$ of $f:X\to S$ over $i:S\to S\prime$, kernel data are injective additive local maps from the pulled-back base ideal $G$ to $j^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$, natural in opens, with image exactly the kernel of the quotient to $\mathcal O_X$. On pulled-back local sections of the base ideal they equal pullback along $Y\to S\prime$. Use the canonical inverse-image adjunction to define the reduction $f^{-1}\mathcal O_{S\prime}\to f^{-1}\mathcal O_S$ and its local inverse-image sections. A representative of a degree-zero cotangent Ext class consists of a sheaf derivation and a chain map to $G[0]$ representing that derived map, normalized on every standard polynomial differential by $b\,dx\mapsto b\,d(\operatorname{ev}x)$. Postcomposition with shifted coefficient maps defines Ext functoriality. A lift torsor is an additive action of Ext-one on marked lift classes, satisfying zero, addition, and unique translation between any two classes. An automorphism identification is a group equivalence from marking-preserving categorical automorphisms to the additive Ext-zero group. For split bases over a field, classification data consist of equivalences of deformation classes with Ext-one for every finite-dimensional direction, the scalar action prescribed by coefficient multiplication, trivial classes exactly zero with an actual trivial lift, addition exactly the recorded deformation addition, and compatibility with actual base changes induced by all linear maps of directions. Dependencies: [def-sfb-marked-scheme-lifts], [lem-trf-lci-cotangent-presentation].
